messages:
noah: Quick Dedicated capacity bulletin: new SKU rollout + a small availability note.

noah: Whats new: NVIDIA H200-160GB (memory-optimized, q4_0) is live as a Reserved Dedicated SKU in me-south-1 and af-south-1 starting today. We also rebalanced some H100 inventory into ap-south-1 to improve burst capacity there.

tess: Awesome. High-level perf callouts?

noah: H200-160GB is aimed at ultra-long-context and multi-model shards. In our internal evals it maintains tail-latency under high concurrency for 64k+ contexts and supports larger KV caches without spilling. Perf/price comparisons vs GH200 and B200 are in the KB.

ops-bot: [system] Inventory update: H200-me-south-1: 8 units, H200-af-south-1: 6 units, H100-ap-south-1 (burst pool): +12 units. Live inventory: /dedicated/inventory

eli: Any special routing rules or contract caveats?

noah: New routing policy "memory_optimized" added: H200 -> B200 -> GH200 -> H100. For enterprise customers you can hard-pin to H200 in Console. Note: H200 units are currently Reserved-only; not available for warm/burst pools.

grace: Can existing Dedicated customers request migrations/upgrades?

noah: Yes  open the "Dedicated capacity change" support flow and include expected sustained throughput. Lead times vary by region (2-8 weeks). For urgent test needs request a test seat.

tess: How can teams validate scheduling before rolling out?

noah: CLI quick-check:
```
rw dedicated check-capacity --region me-south-1 --gpu H200-160 --model ./models/ultra-64k
```
Returns either AVAILABLE or FALLBACK with recommended alternative SKUs and suggested batching profiles.

eli: Any immediate constraints customers should be aware of?

noah: A couple notes: 1) H200 is Reserved-only and subject to commit approval. 2) ap-south-1 H100 burst capacity can be noisier during peak hours; ops will monitor. 3) We added automatic fallback chains to prevent failed requests: if H200 not available route to B200 with quantization profile "q4_mixed".

ops-bot: [system] Small incident earlier this morning: a cold-pool allocation bug caused 1.5h provisioning delays for 3 Dedicated clusters in eu-west-1. Root cause: allocator race when rescheduling interrupted warm-pool transfers. Fix deployed and backlog cleared. No customer data impact. Postmortem in /incidents/1769498700-dedicated-coldpool-race.

tess: Thanks for the incident note. Anything we need to communicate externally?

noah: Not for the incident (internal only). For the H200 launch we will prepare a short customer-facing blurb and TCO examples; Sales + Finance already looped in. I'll post the KB link in a follow-up thread with perf snapshots and exact pricing numbers.

grace: Ops, can you enable test seats for H200 for infra teams?

ops-bot: [system] H200 test cluster provisioning enabled. Request via `/ops request h200-test {team: <team-name>}`. Auto-provision up to 3 seats per team for 7-day trials.

tess: Great, booking a slot to run our multi-agent canary next week. Thanks!

noah: Thanks everyone  please ping if you need help with batching/kv-cache tuning for H200.
